text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's composition proves nothing. Biomedical laboratory science is heavily female-staffed, so an all-women panel is close to what chance would produce — it's a base rate, not a signal. Raising it makes you look like you're explaining away a loss, and it undercuts any legitimate complaint.

Also note the role is managerial. Panels routinely weight management training and leadership breadth over research depth; a PhD and eight years running a section is strong, but not automatically decisive against it.

What is worth pursuing: the unanswered request. You're typically entitled to written reasons. Send a dated follow-up to HR, cite your original request, ask for the assessment criteria and how each finalist scored. Judge the decision on that.
